connector.name: Notify MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: MCP Server for notify to Weixin, Telegram, Bark, Lark, Feishu, DingTalk
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package mcp-notify. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the aahl account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
